email.description: Email address for the registry account.

registry.description: Registry host the credentials are for.

password.description: Password or token for the registry.

data.description: Registry credentials to store in the Secret. Not used when `existingSecret` is set.

enabled.description: Create this image pull secret when true. Accepts a Helm `tpl` string that renders to `true` or `false`.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret to use instead of creating one. When set, only `enabled`, `targetSelectAll` and `targetSelector` are used.

namespace.description: Namespace to create this object in. Overrides the chart-wide `namespace` and `global.namespace`.

labels.description: Additional labels for image pull secret

annotationsList.description: Additional annotations as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the annotations

labelsList.description: Additional labels as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the labels

annotations.description: Additional annotations for image pull secret

targetSelectAll.description: Add the pull secret to all pods.

targetSelector.description: Names of the workloads to add the pull secret to.

description: Image pull secrets, keyed by name. Each one creates a registry credentials Secret that pods use to pull images from a private registry.
